The {{lcfirst:{{PAGENAME}}}} can only be built on a [[place for lantern]], located in the [[forest near the river]] or near the [[cabin in the woods]]. You need to set up this place first.

{{PAGENAME}}s automatically ignite at dusk and go off at dawn. They shed some light at the surroundings. They can be upgraded to [[lantern|stone lantern]]s after erecting them. Just stand near them and hit "E".

'''Note:''' Those belonging to the [[lantern network]] located in the [[forest near the river|forest]] can not be removed.
